description: This file defines the interface for a StreamSocket class in the net namespace, including methods for connection management, SSL info, ALPN negotiation, and socket tagging.

classes.name: StreamSocket
classes.description: An interface for a stream-oriented socket supporting connection, SSL, ALPN, and socket tagging functionalities.

methods.name: SetBeforeConnectCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback invoked before establishing a connection to set socket options.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection, returning status synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: ConfirmHandshake
methods.description: Confirms TLS handshake completion, especially for early data.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket, cancelling pending IO.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the NetLog associated with the socket.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket has been used for reads or writes.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol negotiated via ALPN.

methods.name: GetPeerApplicationSettings
methods.description: Retrieves data from the ALPS TLS extension if supported.

methods.name: GetSSLCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL certificate request info after a specific connection failure.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for network traffic identification.
